name: G-7 Holdings Inc.
summary: G-7 Holdings Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the automobile, supermarket, and meat-related businesses in Japan. The company operates franchised store that provides car supplies under the AUTOBACS brand; and motorcycle specialty shops that offer motorcycle supplies, parts, and accessories, as well as repair and maintenance services under the Bike World brand name. It also operates supermarkets under the Gyomu Super and Rico's brand names; and Megumi no Sato, a farm shop. In addition, the company builds stores, including proposals for store design, designing interior facilities, and managing construction, as well as commercial facilities, stores, and environment and commercial space…
